appraisal_events.evidence: Malgré sa gêne visible et son bavardage de prétextes ("vous permettez que je l'essuie", "je ne vais pas trop fort"), elle sourit et consent ("ça ne me gêne pas"), puis, à la fin, "elle haussa légèrement les épaules, comme pour dire «vous êtes fou, vous voyez bien que ça me plaît»".
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann's hesitant, pretext-laden advance is met with Odette's smiling permission and closing gesture of amused consent, so the passage culminates in mutual receptivity rather than rebuff, even though the mode of attainment is awkward and self-consciously indirect.

status_effects.explanation: Swann comes out locally ahead: his tentative, over-explained approach is plainly welcomed by Odette rather than refused, giving him the desired physical closeness and her tacit encouragement.

ambiguities: Neither figure is named within this excerpt (only 'elle'/'lui' are used); identity as Swann and Odette is inferred from the passage's well-known context (the orchid/pollen scene of "Un amour de Swann") and the file's chapter scoping rather than an explicit in-window naming.
